paragraphs: The 540i has been a core petrol six-cylinder offering in the 5 Series range since 2017, spanning two generations under one badge. The G30/G31 generation (2017–2023) uses the B58 — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine that's part of BMW's modular B-series family. From 2023, the G60-generation 540i continues with the B58, albeit in a later evolution. The G60 also introduced xDrive as standard on UK-market 540i models (unlike the G30/G31, where it was optional). The B58 is generally well-regarded for its reliability, which is consistent with the broader B-series pattern — no widely reported systemic issue has been established for this engine.
about.boldParagraph: The 540i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol fitted to the 540i from 2017 to the present day, across two generations. The B58 is a modular design that has proven generally reliable in service across BMW's model range. We service timing chain, bearings, water pump, and gaskets as standard on every B58 rebuild.
